column1: # Importer eval cases for 2025: tools/eval_importer.py. A mutation turns a table's
# correctly extracted rows into what a reading defect would give, on the table's first
# page (always shown to the importer); expect is the verdict the importer must give.
# FAIL cases are caught by FAIL or UNSURE; PASS cases must get PASS. Mutations:
#   split-row=<col>    <col> leaves its row for a row of its own (MAE A1 p181, GEM)
#   merge-rows         a data row swallows the next one
#   wrong-value=<col>  a value misread (a digit, a word)
#   kind=<kind>        a data row typed as another kind
#   label=<col>:<text> a column's printed label misread
# Add a case for every miss a person finds.
